diffuse_shadow.policy: Broader and softer blurred shadow than B4; numeric values retained below are historical baseline, not a tested September16 preset.

caption.weight_policy: Slightly bolder visible glyph treatment than B4; compare a heavier face or modest weight treatment in encoded phone-size samples. No new font face validated here.

stroke.treatment: subtle dark edge; avoid a conspicuous hard outline
stroke.status: Tune to renderer and phone-size sample; no tested numeric width yet.

hook.duration_policy: Readable introduction and only useful continued context; retire or deliberately reposition if it obscures the demonstration.

validation: September12 numeric calibration retained as historical baseline. September16 bolder text, more diffuse shadow and subtle stroke are user-requested next-run targets; no new render or preset approval claimed. Inspect encoded phone-size samples with native overlays before adopting values.
scope: Historical rendered calibration plus explicitly untested later refinements. User profile wins; adapt to actual renderer and phone-size proof.
